verdict.rationale: ELSTER is a public web portal, so publishing a robots.txt is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a robots.txt or any crawler-access policy. The only probe concerns the ERiC artifact host timing out, which says nothing about robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
